cases.title: Raft UI Button

summary: Android button outlines are consistently heavier than React, especially the black borders on Save, Add, Continue, Sync, and Delete.
Android's pink fills are slightly darker and more saturated than React's, most noticeably on Sync and Delete.
The Android disabled label is darker gray, and its disabled border is darker and slightly thicker than React's.
Horizontal placement varies by roughly 1–2 rendered pixels: Android Save and Add are slightly farther left, while Delete is slightly farther right.
likelyCauses: Android border stroke width and corner-radius tokens do not match the React button styles.
Android and React use different pink and disabled-state color tokens.
Density scaling or rasterization changes the apparent Android stroke weight.
Small padding or fixed-dimension differences cause component-bound drift.

Use the exact React pink fill, disabled text color, and disabled border color in the Android theme.
Match React's button widths, heights, content insets, and row gaps, measuring outer bounds including the stroke.
Re-run Slock after the token and spacing updates to reduce the 5.49% mismatch below the 2% tolerance.
